headline: Midwestern State stand alone without a defeat
dek: Midwestern State have won thirteen and drawn four without a defeat, conceding thirteen goals all season. They close their conference season at home to St. Mary's on Wednesday; Oklahoma Christian, the only other side unbeaten in conference play, have already finished theirs.
displaced_by: Midwestern State's win over Sul Ross State made it thirteen wins, and Jake Morris's published shutouts no longer read five, so the standing dek was no longer true. The headline still holds and stands verbatim.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Thirteen different players have scored Midwestern State's 48 goals, and Parker Plaxco has fourteen of them.

wire.line: Midwestern State and Oklahoma Christian have yet to lose a conference match, and they drew with each other.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
